tanitim.hero_baslik_1: From the floor to the office,
tanitim.hero_alt: MES + ERP for SME manufacturers. Live floor data unifies work orders, maintenance, inventory and quality in one dashboard.
tanitim.moduller_alt: From production to commerce, safety to intelligence. Every module speaks the same language: same button, same table, same control room.
tanitim.mod_uretim_ac: Machine status, OEE, work orders and a digital twin. Field readings reach the dashboard in seconds; critical machines read at a glance.
tanitim.mod_stok_ac: Held balances, critical-stock alerts and multi-line approval flow with separation of duties.
tanitim.mod_kalite_ac: Inspections, nonconformities and CAPA; energy consumption trended on a hypertable.
tanitim.mod_isgik_ac: Incidents, a 5×5 risk matrix, personnel, leave approvals and certificate tracking.
tanitim.mod_ticari_ac: CRM, a contract state machine, request management and a commercial dashboard.
tanitim.mod_dokuman_ac: Versioned document management (object storage) and real-time announcements.
tanitim.mod_zeka_ac: KPI dashboards, AI forecasts and PDF / XLSX report generation.
tanitim.mod_yonetim_ac: Users, roles and permissions, subscription and module entitlement, platform administration.
tanitim.nasil_baslik: From the floor to the dashboard, in seconds
tanitim.nasil_alt: A single data line from the edge device to the control room. Data is not lost even when the connection drops.
tanitim.adim_saha_ac: The edge agent collects readings from machines. If the link drops, store-and-forward keeps them, then delivers.
tanitim.adim_iletim_ac: Readings flow over MQTT to the ingestion worker, queued and de-duplicated.
tanitim.adim_isleme_ac: Production data becomes OEE. Modules publish events safely through an outbox.
tanitim.adim_kontrol_ac: Dashboard and kiosk update live over WebSocket, with no page refresh.
tanitim.persona_alt: A dashboard that shapes itself to the role: nobody drowns in data they do not need.
tanitim.persona_operator_ac: Status at a glance on a big screen: machine, OEE, work order and fault. Short attention, clear signal.
tanitim.persona_yonetici_ac: Cross-module data, dense filtered tables and period reports. One dashboard instead of scattered spreadsheets.
tanitim.persona_sorumlu_ac: Only their own modules and data. The warehouse lead sees their own panel, not the whole factory.
tanitim.platform_alt: The same solid ground for one plant or for many.
tanitim.plat_izolasyon_ac: Each plant in its own schema. Data never mixes in any query.
tanitim.plat_rbac_ac: Permission-based access. The requester cannot approve; sensitive fields are masked.
tanitim.plat_entitlement_ac: Turn modules on or off by plan and apply seat limits. Effect is instant.
tanitim.plat_dis_ac: Customers and suppliers reach a company-scoped, shell-less portal.
tanitim.plat_webhook_ac: Signed event delivery (HMAC) and scope-allowlisted API keys.
tanitim.plat_gerceklzaman_ac: WebSocket liveness, a WCAG 2.1 AA target, TR and EN interface.
tanitim.cta_alt: Connect to your factory's production intelligence. From the floor to the office, everything at a glance.

guvenlik.aciklama: Two-factor authentication and the devices you are signed in on.
guvenlik.aktif_aciklama: Your account is protected with an authenticator code. Turning it off requires your password and a valid code.
guvenlik.pasif_aciklama: Protect your account with a second layer using an authenticator app.

guvenlik.qr_aciklama: Scan the QR code below with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…).
guvenlik.el_ile_giris: If you cannot scan the QR, enter this key manually:
guvenlik.kod_gir_aciklama: Enter the 6-digit code generated by the app to confirm the setup.
guvenlik.kurtarma_aciklama: Use these codes to sign in if you lose access to your phone. Each code works once and this screen is never shown again.

uyum.denetim_aciklama: Who did what, when, and on which record. Entries are immutable (append-only).
uyum.denetim_bos: No audit entries match your filters.
uyum.kvkk_aciklama: Personal data export, anonymization and consent records.
uyum.ihrac_aciklama: The selected person's personal data across all modules is packaged as a ZIP; download it once ready.
uyum.anonim_uyari: This action is IRREVERSIBLE: the person's identifying data is permanently masked. The operation is written to the audit log.
uyum.aydinlatma_kabul: I have read the privacy notice
uyum.saklama_notu: Ready exports are deleted automatically after 7 days (data minimisation); an expired record stays listed for audit but cannot be downloaded.
uyum.ihrac_suresi_doldu: This export's retention period has ended; create a new request.
